parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Experiment 1
Use a measuring cylinder to pour 20cm of solution G into the polystyrene cup provided.
Put the cup into a 250 cm beaker for support. Measure the initial temperature of the
solution and record it in the table below.
Fill the burette with the aqueous sodium hydroxide provided to the 0.0 cm mark.
Add 5.0 cm of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the solution of G in the cup and stir the
mixture.
Measure and record the maximum temperature of the solution in the table below. Add
a further 5.0 cm of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the cup and stir the mixture. Measure
and record the maximum temperature of the mixture in the table below.
Continue to add 5.0 cm portions of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the cup, until a total
volume of 40cm of aqueous sodium hydroxide has been added. Stir after each addition
and measure and record the maximum temperatures in the table.
Pour the solution away and rinse the polystyrene cup.
